review_method: Actual private tool vision of exact reference and every generated source sheet; static six-pose sheets, not timed gameplay. No image output was forwarded to parent/user.

reference.identity: Muscular red biped; two black swept horns; heavy spiked dark armor; skull belt/chains; two arms/two clawed legs; attached thick tail; RIGHT-hand iron axe; LEFT empty claw; no wings. Do not recolor white based on the name.

identity_observation.scope: Species/major armor/weapon appearance in private static source sheets
identity_observation.observation: Dedicated new sources restore red muscular demon anatomy, swept horns, spiked armor, skull belt, tail and actual axe instead of the previous lava-fist golem. This does not grant completed mythic production approval.

frames.observation: Right lower leg reaches the lowest foot line with splayed flattened toes; left knee/foot is raised on screen-right above the planted sole.
Left lower leg reaches the low foot line with splayed toes; right knee/foot is raised on screen-left. Axe remains screen-left RIGHT hand and left hand empty, so this is not a whole-body mirror.

representative_support_repair.improvement: Prior S-v01 did not establish opposite support; new S-v02 exposes opposite anatomical toeplant in phases0/3.
representative_support_repair.limit: Static pose support only. Phase1/2 ordering, full cycle timing, ground-plane collision and actual moving-world contact remain NOT_REVIEWED. No whole six-phase gait approval.

E.observation: Right-facing body is visible, but frontal chest/skullbelt presentation reads closer to three-quarter SE than a clear pure E profile; opposite anatomical support is not established.

SE.observation: Front-right orientation is visible and identity preserved; exposed foreground support appears similar between phases0/3, so the six-phase alternating gait is not approved.

S.observation: Front identity and right-hand axe/left empty hand preserved. Opposite anatomical toeplant in phases0/3 is actually visible. Full cycle timing and contact remain unreviewed.

SW.observation: New v02 corrects previous wrong right-facing v01 to LEFT-facing. The distinction between frontal-left SW and W remains weak and needs in-game camera review; opposite support not established.

W.observation: Clear left-facing orientation; torso retains some frontal presentation and W/SW camera separation is not independently approved. Opposite support not established.

NW.observation: New v03 preserves broad BACK-left, rear armor/tail origin, near LEFT empty claw and far RIGHT hand gripping axe on screen-right. This repairs ambiguous/swapped weapon ownership in v01. Alternating anatomical foot support remains unapproved.

N.observation: Back-only silhouette with no front face/chest and axe held on anatomical RIGHT=screen-right is clear. Rear support leg alternation is not established.

NE.observation: Broad back-right silhouette distinct from front-right is visible; right hand holds axe on screen-right, left hand empty. Opposite support not established.
